approval_source: Explicit user approval in conversation on 2026-10-11; Account plan phase issue https://github.com/minoveaz/loopdev-v2/issues/32.

requirements.title: Provide a LoopDev-native Profile destination
acceptance_criteria: The signed-in Profile menu operation resolves to a LoopDev-native destination rather than the Rivera template/mock page.
The personal profile is global to the authenticated user and includes editable display name and avatar; authentication credentials remain in Security.
Desktop web, mobile web, iOS and Android support the same profile operations with platform-adapted interactions.

requirements.title: Provide a LoopDev-native Account Settings destination
acceptance_criteria: The signed-in Account Settings menu operation resolves to a LoopDev-native destination rather than the Rivera template/mock page.
Personal settings include language, timezone, appearance and personal notifications; language, timezone and notifications sync by user, while appearance may adapt per device.
Organization settings and membership remain in the existing tenant-scoped Platform Settings capability at /app/settings.

requirements.title: Provide a LoopDev-native Security destination
acceptance_criteria: The signed-in Security menu operation resolves to a LoopDev-native destination rather than the Rivera template/mock page.
Security operations cover password/email changes, MFA management and provider-backed sign-out of all other sessions; no individual device inventory is fabricated.
The same operations are available on desktop web, mobile web, iOS and Android; unsupported provider behavior is never represented as success.

requirements.title: Provide a LoopDev-native Billing destination
acceptance_criteria: The signed-in Billing menu operation resolves to a LoopDev-native destination rather than the Rivera template/mock page.
Billing belongs to the active organization; only Owner/Admin users may view or manage plan, invoices, payment methods, upgrades, downgrades and cancellation.
The destination does not expose sample prices, sample payment details or mock invoices as authoritative LoopDev billing data; provider selection is a design decision.

semantics.validation_contract: Account navigation requires an authenticated session; route-unavailable is explicit and legacy routes redirect to canonical LoopDev account paths.

mobile_web.surface: Responsive authenticated web Topbar and shared routes

ios.surface: Native account destinations with the same operations and adapted UX

android.surface: Native account destinations with the same operations and adapted UX

semantics.validation_contract: Only the authenticated user's own global profile is mutable; display name and avatar reference are validated by the shared Profile contract; stale versions return save_conflict.

mobile_web.surface: Responsive LoopDev-native Profile with the same operations

android.surface: Native Profile with the same operations and adapted UX

capabilities.name: Personal account preferences

semantics.validation_contract: Only the authenticated user's preferences are mutable; locale and IANA timezone are validated; language/timezone/notifications sync by user, appearance may be device-local; stale versions return save_conflict.

ios.surface: Native personal preferences with the same operations and adapted UX

android.surface: Native personal preferences with the same operations and adapted UX

semantics.validation_contract: Sensitive operations require a live authenticated session and provider-required reauthentication/AAL; email remains pending until confirmed; unsupported provider operations must return operation_unsupported, never success.

desktop_web.surface: LoopDev-native Security using authoritative AuthPort/provider operations

mobile_web.surface: Responsive Security with shared AuthPort semantics

ios.surface: Native Security with the same operations and adapted provider flows

android.surface: Native Security with the same operations and adapted provider flows

permissions: authenticated user may manage their own security; reauthentication required for sensitive actions

capabilities.name: Customer subscription and billing surface

semantics.validation_contract: Server derives the authenticated member and active organization, enforces Owner/Admin on each operation, verifies provider customer mapping, and returns only tenant-scoped summaries.

desktop_web.surface: Organization Billing for authorized Owner/Admin users

mobile_web.surface: Responsive organization Billing with shared operations

ios.surface: Native organization Billing with the same operations and adapted UX

android.surface: Native organization Billing with the same operations and adapted UX

permissions: active organization Owner/Admin only; enforce on the server and in every client

tasks.title: Record the Account implementation environment truth
acceptance_criteria: Branch, HEAD, checkout type, working-tree changes and runtime status are recorded from direct environment evidence.
No runtime, test, or behavior claim is inferred from source presence.

validation.command: npm run delivery:validate -- --suite platform --module Account --run MOD-ACCOUNT-20261010-001

tasks.title: Audit shared Platform, UI and native component reuse
acceptance_criteria: Reuse decisions and actual source-backed consumers are listed for web and native controls.
No duplicate shell, select, uploader, queue, or cross-module contract is planned.

tasks.title: Audit existing mock flows and replacement boundaries
acceptance_criteria: The four web menu paths and their Rivera route targets are identified.
The four native menu rows are identified as non-navigating; Settings ownership remains outside Account.

tasks.title: Audit Account routes, shell selection and native navigation
acceptance_criteria: Canonical and legacy route behavior is distinguished from current runtime behavior.
Web guard, direct route, refresh, back, native route and deep-link gaps are recorded.

tasks.title: Audit operation-level Account states
acceptance_criteria: Loading, empty, error, forbidden, conflict, offline, pending and success states are mapped to the approved state matrix.
Unsupported operations cannot be rendered as success or sample data.

tasks.title: Audit accessibility, localization and renderer adaptations
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard, screen-reader announcements, touch targets, responsive behavior, safe areas, native back and RTL/i18n acceptance are planned.
Web and native controls remain renderer-specific with equivalent operation meaning.

tasks.title: Audit security boundaries and rollback safety
acceptance_criteria: Self and tenant scopes, server authorization, sensitive-data exclusions, cache invalidation and offline eligibility are recorded.
Mobile Auth false successes, unscoped local queue and safe rollback constraints are identified.

tasks.title: Audit architecture boundaries and dependency direction
acceptance_criteria: Account is limited to navigation/composition; Auth, Files, Preferences and Billing retain domain ownership.
Shared contracts precede adapters/renderers and no provider/storage imports are planned in components.

tasks.title: Audit capability ownership and responsibility separation
acceptance_criteria: Presentation, application, domain, adapter, persistence, authorization and synchronization owners are named.
No duplicate Settings, profile aggregate, mock billing store or Account audit store is planned.

tasks.title: Audit refactor preservation, regression and rollback evidence
acceptance_criteria: Existing auth protection and `/app/settings` behavior have explicit regression criteria.
Legacy account routes can redirect without returning users to mock success paths; rollback disables capability instead of restoring mock mutations.

tasks.title: Define shared Account destination and deep-link semantics
acceptance_criteria: All four destination operations have stable IDs, protected route meaning and explicit legacy redirect behavior.
Web and native routing consume the same semantics without importing renderer code into the contract.

tasks.title: Approve and define canonical PlatformUser profile updates
acceptance_criteria: The shared Auth/Profile contract updates only canonical `PlatformUser.fullName/avatarUrl` fields for the authenticated subject.
Consumer impact, versioning, errors, concurrency behavior and contract tests are approved before renderer work.

tasks.title: Approve and define user-owned synchronized Preferences
acceptance_criteria: Shared contract defines user-scoped language, timezone, notification preferences, device-local appearance, versions, conflicts and errors.
Web, mobile-web and native consumers use the same operation IDs and approved locale/timezone catalogs.

tasks.title: Approve Auth-owned Account security operations
acceptance_criteria: Password/email/MFA/security-state contracts enforce subject binding and provider-required reauthentication.
Sign-out-other-sessions uses the provider-supported scope operation; individual session inventory/revocation is out of scope and is not fabricated.

validation.command: npm run validate:contracts && npm run validate:mobile-boundaries

tasks.title: Approve provider-neutral organization Billing contract
acceptance_criteria: Shared operations define organization scope, Owner/Admin authorization, provider-confirmed outcomes and safe errors without provider-specific client types.
Finance and Platform approve terms, permission/audit ownership, consumer/version impact and contract tests.

tasks.title: Implement the approved user-owned avatar and profile adapter
acceptance_criteria: Profile adapter persists only the authenticated user's allowlisted canonical fields.
Avatar upload, ownership, validation, signed/public URL, orphan cleanup and deletion follow an approved Files policy; no Account-local uploader/queue is added.

tasks.title: Implement identity-bound Preferences persistence and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Synced preferences use stable user identity, versioned/idempotent mutations, explicit conflict/retry states and reauthorization.
Offline queue storage, logout/restart recovery and legacy local-value migration have approved privacy-safe behavior; no replay crosses identity.

tasks.title: Remove mobile Auth false success and unsafe session boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Password/reset/sign-out operations return provider-confirmed outcomes and surface remote failures; no no-op success or swallowed provider failure remains.
Native session storage and organization-role resolution use verified secure, server-authoritative sources; no localStorage/memory credential fallback or unsafe role mapping.

tasks.title: Implement provider-backed sign-out of other Auth sessions
acceptance_criteria: The authenticated user can request provider-supported sign-out of all other sessions, with provider errors surfaced and no Auth internal-table writes.
No individual session/device inventory or per-session revocation is shown or claimed.

tasks.title: Implement organization-scoped Billing authority and provider integration
acceptance_criteria: Server resolves authenticated actor, active organization and Owner/Admin role for every read/mutation; cross-tenant references and user-supplied customer IDs are rejected.

Provider result/webhook is signature-verified and idempotent; audit is shared/approved; provider recommendation, tax/invoice terms and entitlements are approved; no credentials or fictitious billing data reach clients.

tasks.title: Render Profile and account navigation on desktop web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_profile_destination, read_profile, update_display_name, change_avatar are explicitly covered on desktop_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. Topbar opens the LoopDev Profile at `/app/account/profile`; existing `/account/profile` is a protected compatibility redirect and `/app/settings` is unchanged.
Profile read/name/avatar actions use shared ports, existing Rivera primitives, self-only scope and truthful loading/error/forbidden/conflict states.

tasks.title: Adapt Profile and account navigation for mobile web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_profile_destination, read_profile, update_display_name, change_avatar are explicitly covered on mobile_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. The same Profile operations and states work at narrow mobile-web viewports with touch targets of at least 44 CSS px and no hover-only action.
Direct route, refresh, back, keyboard/focus, RTL and file-upload errors are covered without changing shared semantics.

tasks.title: Implement native Profile destinations for iOS and Android
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_profile_destination, read_profile, update_display_name, change_avatar are explicitly covered on ios and android with operation-level acceptance evidence. Both iOS and Android expose the same Profile operations through native routes and reuse native UI/tokens, not web/DOM controls.
System back, safe area, keyboard, touch accessibility, avatar permission and identity-switch cache clearing are verified on both platforms.

tasks.title: Render personal Preferences on desktop web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_account_settings_destination, read_preferences, change_language, change_timezone, change_appearance, change_personal_notifications are explicitly covered on desktop_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. Language, timezone, appearance and personal notification operations use approved controls and shared preference semantics.
The page reports synced/pending/conflict/offline states truthfully and leaves organization preferences in `/app/settings`.

tasks.title: Adapt personal Preferences for mobile web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_account_settings_destination, read_preferences, change_language, change_timezone, change_appearance, change_personal_notifications are explicitly covered on mobile_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. All five preference operations remain discoverable and operable at mobile-web widths using existing Select/Popover/Command or approved equivalent, not native HTML select.
Touch, keyboard, screen-reader, RTL and pending/conflict/offline feedback remain visible and accessible.

tasks.title: Implement native Preferences destinations for iOS and Android
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_account_settings_destination, read_preferences, change_language, change_timezone, change_appearance, change_personal_notifications are explicitly covered on ios and android with operation-level acceptance evidence. Both OSes implement the same five preference operation IDs using native select sheets/switches and the shared persistence contract.
Offline pending, restart recovery, identity binding, safe area, system back, touch and locale changes are tested on each OS.

tasks.title: Render provider-backed Security on desktop web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_security_destination, read_security_status, change_password, change_email, manage_mfa, sign_out_other_sessions are explicitly covered on desktop_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. Password/email/MFA/session actions display only provider-confirmed results and enforce reauthentication/challenges.
No sample session/device, local mutation success or stale sensitive cache is rendered.

tasks.title: Adapt provider-backed Security for mobile web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_security_destination, read_security_status, change_password, change_email, manage_mfa, sign_out_other_sessions are explicitly covered on mobile_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. The same Security operations, reauth states and explicit unsupported/error behavior work at mobile-web widths and touch targets.
Refresh, back, focus restoration, OTP alternatives, RTL and cache clearing after sign-out are covered.

tasks.title: Implement native Security destinations for iOS and Android
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_security_destination, read_security_status, change_password, change_email, manage_mfa, sign_out_other_sessions are explicitly covered on ios and android with operation-level acceptance evidence. Both OSes use secure Auth storage and provider-backed password/email/MFA/session operations.
Native reauthentication, OS back, keyboard/safe area, accessibility, session expiry and identity/cache purge are verified without secrets in storage or logs.

validation.command: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform all --output-dir /tmp/loopdev-account-security-final-export

tasks.title: Render authorized organization Billing on desktop web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_billing_destination, read_subscription, change_plan, cancel_subscription, manage_payment_methods, view_invoice are explicitly covered on desktop_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. Subscription, invoice, payment-method, plan and cancellation operations use the active organization and server-enforced Owner/Admin policy.
No demo data or stale financial cache is shown; payment/portal handoff is short-lived and confirmed state is reread from the authority.

tasks.title: Adapt authorized organization Billing for mobile web
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_billing_destination, read_subscription, change_plan, cancel_subscription, manage_payment_methods, view_invoice are explicitly covered on mobile_web with operation-level acceptance evidence. All Billing operations remain available with the same server authorization and pending/error outcomes at mobile-web sizes.
No offline invoice/portal cache; confirmation, touch, keyboard/back, RTL and active-organization change behavior are covered.

tasks.title: Implement authorized Billing destinations for iOS and Android
acceptance_criteria: Operation IDs open_billing_destination, read_subscription, change_plan, cancel_subscription, manage_payment_methods, view_invoice are explicitly covered on ios and android with operation-level acceptance evidence. Both OSes enforce the same active-organization Owner/Admin operations and use only an approved secure provider handoff.
Native safe area, touch, back/return deep link, role loss, tenant switch and provider cancellation/failure are verified; no sensitive Billing data is persisted offline.

tasks.title: Verify all Account destination routes and navigation parity
acceptance_criteria: Every destination opens by menu and direct URL/deep link, preserves auth guard, supports refresh/back, and redirects legacy web URLs without showing Rivera account mocks.
Desktop, mobile web, iOS and Android resolve the same destination meanings; `/app/settings` regression passes.

tasks.title: Verify Profile operation results and self-scope
acceptance_criteria: Read, display-name update and avatar actions have shared contract evidence and renderer action tests on every platform.
Cross-user update is rejected; upload/validation/version failure preserves canonical profile and never reports a false save.

tasks.title: Verify Preferences sync, conflict and offline behavior
acceptance_criteria: Same preference operations are tested through web/native adapters; local preference mutation remains visibly pending until authoritative acceptance.
Conflict, retry, logout/restart, user switch, organization switch, theme-local and legacy import rules pass without cross-identity replay.

tasks.title: Verify provider-confirmed Security operations
acceptance_criteria: Password, email, MFA and supported session operations have provider-backed action evidence and step-up/unsupported/error coverage on all platforms.
No password, OTP, recovery secret or token is persisted/logged; expired/revoked sessions clear sensitive cache and no offline mutation succeeds.

tasks.title: Verify tenant isolation and provider-confirmed Billing operations
acceptance_criteria: Owner/Admin can access only the active organization's provider-backed operations; other roles and foreign organization/resource IDs are denied server-side.
Provider failures, webhook replay, pending cancellation/plan change, payment handoff expiry and role/tenant changes never grant entitlement or leak invoice/payment data.
